programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: The Walking Dead

programme.title: Sinbad: Where U Been?
programme.desc: The comic performs at the Club Nokia Theatre in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Dennis Gaxiola: Before the Wall Goes Up
programme.desc: Dennis Gaxiola gained notoriety from his appearances with Jamie Foxx on Comedy Central, the Latin Kings of Comedy Tour with Paul Rodriguez, BET's Comic View, Que Locos and the 2010 season of Martin Lawrence's First Amendment Stand Up.

programme.title: Dennis Miller: America 180
programme.desc: Dennis Miller shares his opinion on today's America, including the current state of the nation, the failures of Obama's healthcare initiative and the antics of our top leaders.

programme.title: Dennis Miller: Fake News, Real Jokes
programme.desc: Dennis Miller's critical assessment of the current climate, from fake news to selfies.

programme.title: Doug Stanhope: The Comedians' Comedian's Comedians
programme.desc: Doug Stanhope has traveled the world and made himself a real comedian's comedian; with Brendon Walsh, Morgan Murphy, and Glenn Wool in this comedy special shot during Austin, TX's South by Southwest.

programme.title: Doug Stanhope: No Place Like Home
programme.desc: Doug Stanhope performs live in his hometown of Bisbee, Arizona.

programme.title: Erik Terrell: Live at the Helium Comedy Club
programme.desc: Erik Terrell performs in front of a sold out room at Helium Comedy Club in Philadelphia.

programme.title: Even More Funny Women of a Certain Age
programme.desc: Golden Globe winner Teri Hatcher joins the stage with some of the funniest women in comedy for one night of over-the-top, uninhibited standup.

programme.title: Felicia Madison: Better Than Sex
programme.desc: In Felicia's first comedy special she covers it all - childhood, marriage, kids and even depression.

programme.title: Gina Yashere: Laughing To America
programme.desc: Gina Yashere takes the stage to perform her unapologetically hilarious stand-up routine.

programme.title: Graham Elwood: Manifest It
programme.desc: Veteran stand-up comic Graham Elwood unloads his comedic takes on new age people in LA, having college professor father, watching cult documentaries, the failed two party system and why hippies need ads during NFL games.

programme.title: Greg Ware: Just Love Everybody
programme.desc: Greg Ware performs his musical comedy routine for his audience, pulling his humor from his writing, acting and teaching careers.

programme.title: J-L Cauvin: Half Blackface
programme.desc: Comedian J-L Cauvin addresses growing up the son of mixed-race parents and how the pandemic turned out to be his superhero origin story.

programme.title: Larry the Cable Guy: Remain Seated
programme.desc: Larry the Cable Guy is back to "Git R Done" in his latest solo special from the Rialto Square Theater in Joliet, IL.

programme.title: Larry the Cable Guy: Remain Seated
programme.desc: Larry the Cable Guy is back to "Git R Done" in his latest solo special from the Rialto Square Theater in Joliet, IL.

programme.title: Whitney Cummings: Money Shot
programme.desc: One of the funniest comics on television.

programme.title: Anjelah Johnson: Mahalo & Goodnight
programme.desc: Filmed at the Hawaii Theater in Honolulu, Hawaii, Anjelah Johnson's fourth stand-up comedy special dishes on awkward massages, home invasions, spiders and being a full-grown child.

programme.title: Jesus Trejo: Stay at Home Son
programme.desc: Mexican-American comic Jesus Trejo explores his upbringing as an only child to immigrant parents; he recalls learning many of life's lessons in the most unconventional ways, all the while feeling the need to meet his parents' high expectations.

programme.title: Paul Rodriguez: The Here and Wow
programme.desc: Veteran comedian, Paul Rodriguez hits the stage to give his perspectives on life, from being peer pressured into believing in God to claiming to be the village idiot.

programme.title: Saul Trujillo: Yolanda
programme.desc: Does "Variety's top comic to watch" look like Selena's murderer? Find out why cruises are terrible, and the homeless tent problem isn't the problem one thinks it is.

programme.title: Kylie Brakeman: Linda Hollywood's Big Night
programme.desc: Character comedian Kylie Brakeman teaches an acting masterclass as Linda Hollywood, a problematic, old school talent agent on a mission to spread her industry wisdom-and save her own career in the process.

programme.title: David Huntsberger: One Headed Beast
programme.desc: A bizarre robo-scientist and his human-animal assistants test hypotheses.

programme.title: Erica Rhodes: I Love You More
programme.desc: Erica Rhodes has made various stage appearances.

programme.title: Finesse Mitchell: The Spirit Told Me To Tell You
programme.desc: Comic Finesse Mitchell returns to the stage with a new stand-up special about adjusting to L.A. life, staying out of nightclubs and juggling the non-stop demands of marriage, fatherhood and adulting.

programme.title: Gina Brillon: The Floor Is Lava
programme.desc: The comic pulls no punches when discussing her childhood, culture and the transition from single to married life with her Midwestern husband.

programme.title: Gina Brillon: Pacifically Speaking
programme.desc: Comic Gina Brillon performs.

programme.title: Jeff Garcia: Low Budget Madness
programme.desc: The comic performs.

programme.title: Jeff Garcia: Livin The Dream
programme.desc: Famed Latino comedian and voiceover artist Jeff Garcia performs his signature improv style at San Manuel Indian Bingo and Casino. He comments on his family, unreliable cars, white people, marriage and his run-ins with the law.

programme.title: Jimmy O. Yang: Guess How Much?
programme.desc: Yang dives into love languages, loser friends and negotiating with his Asian parents.

programme.title: Kevin Hart Presents: Lil Rel Howery: RELevent
programme.desc: Comic Lil Rel Howery explains how he found out that his father wasn't a doctor; the difference between raising a son and a daughter; racism within the black community.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Spark of Insanity
programme.desc: Jeff Dunham returns with new ventriloquist characters by starting off with the infamously known Walter, scrutinizing every bit of today's American society.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Minding the Monsters
programme.desc: In the spirit of Halloween, Jeff Dunham performs with his special cast of characters including Walter, Bubba J, Peanut, Jose and Achmed all decked out in their Halloween best.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Unhinged in Hollywood
programme.desc: Previously unseen stand-up comedy by Jeff Dunham; sketches that include popular characters; Brad Paisley performs; special appearances by comic Chris Parnell and former UFC champion Chuck Liddell.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Arguing With Myself
programme.desc: The comic who has helped reintroduce the lost art of ventriloquism entertains a live audience with a little assistance from three inanimate friends who aren't nearly as wooden as their outer facades may lead you to believe.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: All Over the Map
programme.desc: Comic and ventriloquist Jeff Dunham performs across five continents, accompanied by his well-known characters, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, Peanut, Jose Jalapeño, Bubba J and Walter.

programme.title: Jeff Dunham: Controlled Chaos
programme.desc: A live concert performance that leans heavily on four favorite characters; cranky old man Walter, Achmed the Dead Terrorist, the mischievous purple whatsit and Peanut.

programme.title: Crímenes imperfectos

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Christophe Rocancourt is a French impostor and con artist who scammed rich and powerful people by masquerading in turn as a French nobleman, the heir to the Rockefeller family, or as a Russian prince.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Matthew Cox is a former mortgage broker from Florida who found himself on the Secret Service's most wanted list; he made millions falsifying homeownership and mortgage documents for five times the properties' actual worth.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Jan Lewan is the polka sensation from Pennsylvania who fleeced millions of investors with his classic Ponzi scheme; his name shot to fame when Netflix produced the movie "Polka King" with actor Jack Black playing Jan Lewan.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Nicknamed The Chameleon, Frédéric Bourdin is a former French serial imposter who claims to have faked at least five hundred false identities, including a young Texas boy who went missing in the mid-90s.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Shaun Greenhalgh is a British artist and art forger; between 1989 and 2006, he produced a number of forgeries including Roman and Chinese art objects, and medieval Christian relics, that fooled some of the world's most respected art institutions.

programme.title: Inside the Mind of a Con Artist
programme.desc: Dubbed the "Mini Madoff," Kiener is one of Germany's greatest con artists, tricking thousands of private investors and banks, including Barclays and J.P. Morgan, to the tune of more than $300 million.

programme.title: Mary Mack
programme.desc: Folk Humorist Mary Mack performs her sometimes-musical comedy at festivals, colleges, clubs, casinos and anywhere you can find a llama or a buffet line. She has acted in cartoons, weird student films, and commercials that urge you to buy food for your hamster. (Mary is totally FOR feeding your hamster.) A favorite on radio shows and podcasts around the country, including Marc Maron's WTF Podcast, The Bob and Tom Show, and American Public Media's WITS, Mary played the leading character Dylan on Fox's new late night cartoon Golan the Insatiable, season one. Her voice has also been heard in the cult favorite Aqua Teen Hunger Force on Cartoon Network's Adult Swim. Mack's comedy (spotted with occasional mandolin or clarinet outbursts) has been seen in the Vancouver Comedy Fest, The Andy Kaufman Awards, Montreal's Just For Laughs Festival, and the San Francisco Sketch Fest as one of "The Dozen" up and coming headliners designated by the festival. She had her national TV debut on Comedy Central's Live at Gotham and NBC's Last Comic Standing.

programme.title: Andy Hendrickson
programme.desc: Andy Hendrickson has multiple TV appearances including: The Late Show with David Letterman, The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, Gotham Comedy Live, NBC/Seeso's The Guest List and more. Internationally, Andy has performed at clubs and festivals throughout the world, including Canada, England, Holland, and Ireland. He also performed for our troops on Outback's Feeding Freedom Tour that provided entertainment for the troops on military bases across Afghanistan.

programme.title: Greg Warren
programme.desc: Greg Warren is a nationally touring headliner and has been featured on Late Night with Seth Meyers, Last Comic Standing, Comedy Central Presents, The Late Late Show with Craig Ferguson, BET and CMT. Greg is a fan favorite on the nationally syndicated Bob and Tom Radio Show and can be heard daily on Sirius/XM.

programme.title: Arvin Mitchell
programme.desc: With an array of impressions, stories, gestures and faces, Arvin's memorable performance is sure to please. As the former co-host of BET's Club Comic View, Arvin has been featured on Kevin Heart's “One Mic Stand”, Tony Rocks “The Funny Spot” as well as entertaining our troops abroad. Nominated as one of NBC's Stand Up for Diversity top comics Arvin continues to tour colleges, clubs, cruise ships & churches.

programme.title: Zoltan Kaszas
programme.desc: Zoltan Kaszas was born in Budapest, Hungary and raised in San Diego, California. He first stepped onstage at the age of nineteen and he was hooked immediately. Zoltan's diverse background and life experience along with his conversational storytelling style has been entertaining audiences at comedy clubs and colleges across the country. His comedy has also been featured on the television show Laughs on FOX, on radio at SiriusXM in print in The Atlantic and has helped him win The Seattle International Comedy Competition &The San Diego Comedy Festival. When he isn't traveling the world Zoltan can be found at home with his wife Brittany and their cat Jessica, you can keep up with him on his weekly podcast available on iTunes called This Week In Zoltan.

programme.title: Brian Moote
programme.desc: Brian Moote started performing stand up in 2005 while he was working as a teacher in the Seattle School District. He then went to graduate school to get a masters degree in social work because who doesn't love crippling debt? I mean, this is America. After graduating he moved to LA and now tours the country telling jokes. He has made TV appearances on the USA Network's "Characters Welcome," Nickelodeon's "Nickmom's Nite Out," MTV's "Money from Strangers" and AXS TV's "Gotham Live." You should come out and see him tell jokes... DO IT!!!

programme.desc: Mike Speenberg has been a professional touring Stand-up comedian for 20 years. He's performed on 5 different continents, entertained everyone from Hall of Fame Athletes to US Diplomats, shared the stage with everyone from Robin Williams to Bill Burr, and been featured on everything from CNN to the AMERICAN FORCES RADIO NETWORK.

This captivating series explores the diverse behaviors that define survival—hunting and feeding strategies, family bonds, defense tactics, and the intricacies of courtship and mating. Who reigns supreme in the wild? Discover the untold stories of nature's fiercest competitors and most fascinating creatures.

programme.title: Blue World S8 - "Horse Ferry Shipwreck"
programme.desc: Jonathan explores the wreck of a horse-powered ferry, the only known wreck of its kind in the world. Then Blue World travels to Jackson Blue Springs in Marianna, Florida, where we dive with world-renown cave rescue diver Edd Sorenson.

programme.title: Blue World S8 - "Triple Wreck Dive"
programme.desc: Jonathan, and his camera operators, dive a famous and extremely dangerous cave in Florida known as Friedman Sink, where the current carries you downstream to the exit at Catfish Hotel. Then Blue World heads to the coast to dive off Riviera Beach where the team explores three shipwrecks on a single dive.

programme.title: Blue World S8 - "Blackwater Diving"
programme.desc: The Blue World team divides up into two teams, with one heading to Florida and the other to Hawaii, to experience night dives offshore over thousands of feet of water.

programme.title: Wild And Alive S1 - "Giant's Migration"
programme.desc: Mammoth mammals migrate from the Antarctic to South Africa's coast to mate and give birth, featuring aerial displays and massive feeding frenzies.

programme.title: Shark Divers
programme.desc: Discover one of the most dangerous jobs in the world...shark diving!

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S2 - "Deliverance"

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S3 - "Coming of Age"
programme.desc: Bipin, Yash and Tito finally reach the age when they can start families of their own, but overstep the mark and are ejected from the troop.

programme.title: Monkey Thieves S3 - "Zamir’s Legacy"
programme.desc: Zamir’s estranged twins, Gangol and Ragin, cause untold mayhem on the city streets, proving they’ve inherited the worst of their father’s bad-boy genes.

programme.title: Animal Science S1 - "Predator and Prey"

programme.title: Animal Science S1 - "Fabulous Felines"
programme.desc: We explore the fascinating science behind cats — from their evolution across the globe, including the mighty Saber-toothed Tiger, to how their senses compare with those of other animals. Finally, test your knowledge with a fun quiz packed with amazing feline facts!

programme.title: Animal Science S1 - "Australian Animals"
programme.desc: We journey to the land down under — Australia! Discover the science behind one of the world’s greatest natural wonders, the Great Barrier Reef. Witness the fierce Tasmanian devil in action, and meet the adorable, tree-hugging koala.

programme.title: Bear Whisperer S2 - "You Bad Bear"
programme.desc: In Mammoth Lakes, three young bears roam town for the first time. Bear Whisperer Steve Searles must teach them boundaries before trouble turns tragic.

programme.title: Bear Whisperer S2 - "Breaking & Entering"
programme.desc: A notorious break-in bear returns to Mammoth Lakes with a cub. Steve Searles must stop her dangerous behavior before deadly consequences follow.

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Humpbacks: From Tonga to Antarctica"
programme.desc: Singing louder than any animal on earth, humpback whales are famous for their haunting songs and jaw-dropping acrobatics. They were hunted to the brink of extinction until a moratorium on killing them was implemented in the 1960s.

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Manatees and Dugongs"
programme.desc: Each year, hundreds of critically endangered manatees are killed in U.S. waters by boats, disease and cold weather. 2006 was the worst year on record for manatee deaths 416 animals perished.

programme.title: Blue Realm S1 - "Toxic Invaders"
programme.desc: They're beautiful - and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane. They're lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific.

programme.title: Killer Instincts S1 - "Death by Venom"
programme.desc: From Komodo dragons to black mambas and death stalker scorpions, witness the deadly power of venom and nature’s most feared killers.

programme.title: Killer Instincts S1 - "Epic Enemies"
programme.desc: From lions vs hyenas to whales vs giant squids, witness epic clashes as nature’s fiercest predators battle for dominance and survival.

programme.title: Killer Instincts S1 - "Killer Teeth"
programme.desc: From crocodiles to vipers to great white sharks, explore the deadly power of nature’s sharpest jaws and the killer teeth that rule the wild.

programme.title: Chameleons Of The World S1 - "Chameleons Of The World"
programme.desc: Discover the life of chameleons as they’ve never been seen before. It’s a journey of discovery into the forests of Madagascar, the savannahs of east and southern Africa and the Namib desert.

programme.title: End of the Big Cats S1 - "Lion"
programme.desc: Prosecuted for many decades, Africa’s lion population has declined to only twenty thousand, and many biologists and conservationists are starting an international campaign to save these extraordinary animals.

programme.title: End of the Big Cats S1 - "Leopard"
programme.desc: Leopards are more resistant to extinction because of their elusive behaviour. Leopards are solitary creatures, the quintessential ambush-and-stalking predator, able to find the most remotes places on earth to avoid human contact.

programme.title: End of the Big Cats S1 - "Cheetah"
programme.desc: Cheetahs have already survived one extinction, estimated to have been around 10,000 years ago. Now, seen as a pest by farmers, and hunted vigorously, the cheetah is perilously close to a second exit.

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Who’s A Reptile?"

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "The Kingdom of the Horse"

programme.desc: The animal kingdom is full of mysteries:what exactly is a seahorse,why can’t ostriches fly, why do tigers have stripes and what is an elephant’s trunk?

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Appearances Can Be Deceiving"
programme.desc: Meet animals that aren’t quite what they seem, from the naked mole rat and giraffe-like okapi to the false gharial and its crocodilian counterpart.

programme.sub-title: Big Hairy Spiders & Other Toxic Creatures

programme.title: Animal Atlas S4 - "Skin, Fur & Feathers"
programme.desc: See how animals are covered for life,from the tough skin of turtles,hippos and elephants to the hollow hairs of polar bears and birds’ unique feathers.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape
programme.sub-title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape S01 E01 - India Part 1
programme.desc: Gordon’s odyssey begins in the north, home of our curry house classics. On board an express train he’s thrown in at the deep end and experiences a back-to-basics baptism of fire, cooking for its many passengers in the train’s cramped pantry car and getting travel sick while he’s making curry. In stark contrast he then meets his match working for a cantankerous royal chef, preparing a biryani with a difference for a huge wedding feast before venturing into the jungle where he gets eaten alive by ants when he scales a 40-foot tree in search of the local tribe’s favourite delicacy. Then it’s on to Delhi to cook at the restaurant that invented tandoori chicken, where Gordon puts into practice everything he’s learnt for a tough crowd of Delhi food critics.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape
programme.sub-title: Gordon Ramsay’s Great Escape S01 E02 - India Part 2
programme.desc: Gordon’s got a taste for adventure and heads off the tourist track into impenetrable north-east India, home of the country’s best-kept culinary secrets. Leaving the 21st century behind, he immerses himself in the life of a local meat-loving tribe in Nagaland, once better known for head-hunting than their curries. Then he’s off to Assam to enter a housewives’ competition to find the best Assamese dish; and finally he sets up shop among the street food stalls of Calcutta to try and tempt the local foodies into buying north-east curry – Ramsay style.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Jimena va a casa de Virginia a pedirle que convenza a Carlos Ernesto de irse a realizar un tratamiento para extender su expectativa de vida a una clínica en Europa. Alejandra enfrenta a Leo por haber irrumpido en su casa y él acepta toda responsabilidad. Su padre, Leonardo, considera el despedirlo de la empresa. Leo le confiesa a Alejandra que ya sabe que ella vive con Rodrigo y que él es el padre de María Lucía. Sandra persuade a María Lucía de que le de una oportunidad a Leo. Keka, Miguel y Lucas llaman a Irene, pero sus guardaespaldas se lo cuentan a Rebecca y ella les prohíbe volver a comunicarse con ella. Adolfo propone como sucesor del puesto de Finol a Rodrigo y a Carlos Ernesto y a Leonardo no les queda más remedio que aceptar la propuesta.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Maribel desconfía de Gloria porque cree que está pasando información sobre Leonardo, pero Tony le dice que exagera. Jimena va a visitar a sus nietos que se encuentran castigados y habla con Agustina para que la ayude a controlar a Rebeca. Virginia renuncia a su puesto y le miente a Carlos Ernesto porque cree que así lo está protegiendo. Él habla con María Lucía para descubrir si es verdad lo que le dijo. Leonardo va a la citación para firmar la anulación y trata de hablar con Irene. Esta se niega a cambiar su opinión, mucho más cuando llega Rebeca a la reunión, lo que hace que Leonardo se enoje con ella.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leo se encuentra con María Lucía en la empresa y le declara nuevamente su amor, pero todo se interrumpe cuando Alejandra llega y la echa a María Lucía junto a Sandra del lugar y le pide a Leo que la acompañe a su oficina. Ella le comenta que le va a pedir a Leonardo que lo mandé a otra central de la empresa en las afueras del país por algunos años para que madure. Leonardo llega a la casa y se entera que Rebeca regañó a Lucas, Miguel y Keka y los encerró en la habitación, por lo que decide llamarla inmediatamente y exigirle que vuelva a la casa rápido para discutir sobre el tema.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Manuela revela que Moisés y Elizabeth son hermanos, causando gran dolor y descreimiento. Moisés rechaza a Celia por su supuesto abandono, mientras Néstor oculta que está vivo. Ricardo apoya a Elizabeth y defiende a Manuela de Hortensia. Celia enfrenta un embarazo de riesgo bajo reposo médico. Pese a las tensiones y el acoso de Misael, Manuela reafirma su amor por Ricardo y decide divorciarse de él, mientras Katiuska intenta seducirlo aprovechando la crisis familiar.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo intenta recuperar a Manuela, mientras Katiuska se convierte en su amante para sabotear la relación. Moisés cae en depresión tras descubrir que Elizabeth es su hermana, mientras Celia intenta forzar una convivencia familiar. Benjamín inicia su plan contra los Tariffi manipulando a Hortensia. Tras un viaje de Ricardo y Manuela, Katiuska jura venganza. Finalmente, Celia busca el perdón de Moisés prometiéndole contarle la verdad sobre su pasado.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia convence a Moisés de vivir con ella, mientras él y Elizabeth aceptan su hermandad. Ricardo y Manuela pasan la noche juntos por la lluvia, pero ella lo rechaza pese a los intentos de él por reconciliarse. Katiuska, furiosa, amenaza a Manuela mientras Hortensia planea arruinar su matrimonio. Marcelo oculta su relación con María del Pilar, y Néstor amenaza a Jade, quien delata a Manuela. Brigitte enfrenta problemas de drogas mientras su familia se preocupa por su bienestar.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo intenta recuperar a Manuela, pero ella pide el divorcio tras abandonarlo en la carretera. Mientras Ricardo se embriaga y sufre un accidente, Celia se enfrenta a Benjamín por la maternidad de Moisés. Katiuska y Benjamín planean un desfalco contra la empresa Tariffi aprovechando la crisis de Ricardo. Moisés decide quedarse en el colegio pese a la oposición de su abuela Amparo, y Gustavo presenta a María del Pilar con Graciela sin saber que son rivales.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo sobrevive a un accidente, provocando caos y revelaciones. Katiuska y Benjamín planean estafar a la empresa Tariffi, mientras Celia aprovecha para intrigar contra Manuela y recuperar a Ricardo. Amparo confiesa a Moisés por qué odia a Celia, y Elizabeth intenta imponer su presencia en la familia. Tras su regreso, Ricardo es blanco de las manipulaciones de Celia, quien intenta seducirlo, pero Manuela interviene para evitar que logre sus planes y proteger su vínculo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto brinda con Serrano y Rivero por la compra de las emisoras y pide documentos falsos del apartamento para callar a Natalia. Arminda espera la hora de vengarse mientras Erasto regala un brillante enorme a Natalia. Alejandro y José Luis se emborrachan en confidencias. La policía registra el cuarto de Rosa y encuentra una bolsa con el dinero del falso robo de Rosalía; la arrestan. Blanca se niega a impedirlo. Marisela golpea a Rosalía y Adolfo interviene. Isaías se niega a perdonar a Consuelo. Rosa es advertida de que pasará mucho tiempo presa.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro y José Luis salen borrachos del bar; en la residencia comentan la detención de Rosa. Adolfo le cuenta a Alejandro sobre el robo, y Rosalía visita la residencia furiosa al saber que Alejandro fue a ayudarla. Rosa es trasladada a la cárcel; Junior contrata a un abogado para liberarla y Alejandro intenta verla, pero él se interpone. Erasto entrega a Natalia documentos falsos del apartamento. Marisela llega a la empresa y presenta a Isaías como asesor adjunto a la presidencia. Rosa confiesa a Alejandro su certeza de que Rosalía es la culpable de todo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Andreína sospecha que Rosalía es la culpable y consulta con su padre. Rosalía paga el depósito que la policía retiene. Alejandro decide no ayudar a Rosa, presionado. Eustoquio promete revelar un secreto importante a Rosa. Erasto visita a Eustoquio y se cruza con Rosa burándose de ella. Eustoquio es atacado en prisión y Rosa lo salva gritando pidiendo auxilio. Amalia sufre un accidente en el set y deben operarla en EE.UU. Alejandro pospone la boda con Rosalía. Consuelo contrata al detective Sanabria para investigar a las chicas de la residencia.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Reina le confiesa a Sol y Alejandro sobre el cambio que hizo con su hijo, admitiendo que Alejandrito es hijo de Aída y Alejandro, pero que el hijo de Sol y Alejandro fue cambiado con el hijo de otra mujer. Aída sabe que eso es mentira, pero se niega a decir la verdad, ya que sino Reina no le dirá quién es su verdadera hija. Sol y Alejandro pretenden hacerle pruebas genéticas a todos los niños que nacieron ese día en esa clínica, pero Aída se niega a realizar la prueba con Alejandrito.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri se muestra sorprendida al ver que su deseo de llegar a tener una relación con Juan Diego es ya una realidad al recibir de el la propuesta de un noviazgo | Yubiri se llena de recuerdos que la hacen remontarse a un cercano pasado para decidirse a darle el si a Juan Diego. Carolina discute con Dionisia quien evidentemente afectada por la noticia de su supuesto embarazo la llena de insultos al considerar a su nieta una irresponsable por dejarse embarazar sin anteponer su futuro.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Virginia le cuenta a María Lucía la razón por la cuál decide mentirle a Carlos Ernesto diciéndole que van a irse al interior. María Lucía la entiende y le confiesa que ella también está triste, que no sabe si arriesgarse o no por Leo. Felipe la besa a Irene, por lo que, ella termina disgustándose y pidiéndole a Maribel que la aloje en su casa por un tiempo, pero Maribel le recuerda que si se muda con ella la mentira de que el bebé que está esperando es de Felipe perderá validez. Anzola le aconseja a Leonardo que intente hablar con Irene, que le declare nuevamente su amor para que puedan resolver sus asuntos, pero Leonardo está con muchos problemas, tiene que resolver cuál va a ser el futuro de Leo, el cual está en las manos de Alejandra.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol está convencida de que Aída sabe más de lo que dice sobre el paradero de su hijo. Con el apoyo de Alejandro, sigue adelante con la búsqueda de su hijo y contrata a una especialista para llevar a cabo el examen de ADN de Alejandrito. Aída impide que se lleva adelante el estudio a último momento. Giselle y Bárbara deciden no enfrentarse más y planear juntas cómo reSolver la situación, de manera tal que Torombolo no se enoje con ellas y descubra que ambas le han mentido.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Yubiri se convierte en el causal de la decepción de Wilker al informarlo a el y a sus compañeros de conjunto de su noviazgo con Juan Diego | Solimar sintiéndose aliviada por lo que implica en su relación con Wilker el noviazgo de Yubiri y Juan Diego felicita a su amiga ocultando así sus motivos que la llevan a sentir unos profundos celos | Wilker a pesar de sentirse dolido con la noticia de Yubiri toma la decisión de ocultarle a Yubiri sus sentimientos al ir a festejar con ella su noviazgo.

programme.desc: Yubiri se convierte en el causal de la decepción de Wilker al informarlo a el y a sus compañeros de conjunto de su noviazgo con Juan Diego | Solimar sintiéndose aliviada por lo que implica en su relación con Wilker el noviazgo de Yubiri y Juan Diego felicita a su amiga ocultando así sus motivos que la llevan a sentir unos profundos celos | Wilker a pesar de sentirse dolido con la noticia de Yubiri toma la decisión de ocultarle a Yubiri sus sentimientos al ir a festejar con ella su noviazgo.

programme.title: Voltea pa' que te enamores
programme.sub-title: Episodio 249: Gladis, Luis Fernando y Dileidy
programme.desc: Gladis hace todo lo posible por inscribir el libro de Gabito en el concurso. Doroteo rechaza a La Nena. María gracia le pide a Luis Fernando que lo intente de nuevo pero él la rechaza. Luis Fernando le da dos opciones a Dileidy antes de casarse.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Celia irrumpe en casa de Ricardo, generando tensión con Manuela y Hortensia, quien exige el divorcio de la pareja. Ricardo se niega y decide reconocer al hijo de Celia. Katiuska atenta contra Verónica para sacarla de las empresas Tariffi mediante chantajes. Mientras tanto, Elizabeth sufre un accidente provocado por Carlos Eduardo tras ser agredida por un demente. Manuela sospecha que María del Pilar es amante de Marcelo, mientras Ricardo busca enmendar sus errores para recuperar a Manuela.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Junior pide al abogado acelerar la libertad de Rosa. Rosa confirma a José Luis que Rosalía fue la culpable. Rosalía descubre el embarazo de Rosa con Alejandro y le exige a Marisela ayudarla a huir del país antes del interrogatorio policial. Marisela apoya el viaje. Rosa pide ayuda a Arminda para que su madre no pase necesidades; Arminda le promete compensarla de un modo que ni siquiera imagina. Robert recibe a sus padres en el aeropuerto. Adolfo se niega a oír las acusaciones de Consuelo contra Rosalía. Erasto le compra un gimnasio entero a Natalia.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Carlos Ernesto convence a Virginia para que lo acompañe a Alemania, pero Trinidad hace lo posible para evitar que Virginia vaya y le cuenta a Jimena para que impida esto. Leo deberá irse a Europa sin contarle nada a nadie antes de que Alejandra lo envíe a otro lugar como castigo de la irrupción a su apartamento. Julio lo descubre haciendo las maletas, por lo que Leo le cuenta del viaje y los celos de Julio comienzan una problemática. María Lucía, sin saber nada del viaje, decide ir en busca de Leo para confesarle su amor por él.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Alejandro y Sol tratan de que Aída coopere para llegar a la verdad sobre el paradero de sus hijos, Aída se reúsa por miedo y Reina la presiona. Merced a la intervención de Alejandro y Sol, Aída no cae en el juego de Reina y ellos terminan por revelarle que su hija está muerta. Alicia amenaza directamente a Maricielo y esta la hace echar de la comisaría. Cuando Carlos busca un nuevo empleo, consigue uno como defensor público y le asignan el caso de Heriberto Madroño.

programme.desc: Danny desenvolveu uma máquina do tempo que definitivamente funcionará desta vez. No entanto, em uma de suas equações está faltando alguns dígitos e os Guerreiros se encontram em um tempo antes do Big Bang. Eles devem encontrar uma maneira de fazer o Big Bang acontecer ou nada existirá.Ao passar por uma névoa, a Baleia Espacial passa por estranhas dificuldades técnicas.

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Isso nao esta funcionando, Bom Dia para Comecar de Novo
programme.desc: Quando Danny é abandonado por sua namorada, ele lida com suas emoções dolorosas como um adulto maduro... vendendo elas para um Sugador de Emoções do mercado negro.No casamento da irmã da Plum, Chris deve fazer Plum acreditar no amor verdadeiro ou ele e os outros Guerreiros Bravos estão condenados a NUNCA experimentá-lo!

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: A boca esta viva com sucos como vinho, Bang, Bang, Bang na porta, cara
programme.desc: Wallow, decidindo que quer comer da forma mais ética possível, embarca em uma "dieta fantasma" da moda - mas os efeitos negativos em sua saúde física e mental rapidamente se tornam aparentes. Após uma grande briga sobre alguns spoilers nada legais, os Bravos Guerreiros vão para salas separadas para desabafar. Mas cada um deles causa seu próprio tipo de caos, resultando em destruição inesperada.

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Eu simplesmente nao consigo lidar sem meu sabao, Guerra sem lagrimas
programme.desc: É turno da noite no pronto-socorro enquanto Wallow treina para tirar sua licença de enfermagem. Mas quando o caos irrompe, ele deve trocar bacias por bisturis e aprender as duras verdades sobre a enfermagem. Os Bravos Guerreiros descobrem que sua realidade é, na verdade, um "videogame" projetado para entreter Seres Superiores.

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Fora de alcance, nunca bom o bastante, Me leva pra casa, por favor
programme.desc: É o femiversário da Plum, o dia em que Plum está criando curvas femininas. Mas quando a festa cuidadosamente planejada, mas executada de forma barata, do Chris não corresponde às suas expectativas, ela tem uma série de acessos de raiva, revivendo o femiversário mais luxuosamente decorado de todos os tempos... o de sua mãe.

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Seja la o que o futuro nos reserve – parte 1, Seja la o que o futuro nos reserve – parte 2
programme.desc: Os Bravos Guerreiros viajam para a See-Thru Zone para finalmente resgatar seus pais. Mas os Courageous Battlers QUEREM ser resgatados? O QUE ESTÁ ACONTECENDO?!? Com os lutadores corajosos alegremente presos na Zona Invisível, os Bravos Guerreiros retornam aos negócios como de costume... exceto que agora eles parecem estar felizes também?! ALGO ESTÁ TERRIVELMENTE, TERRIVELMENTE ERRADO E ESTÁ FICANDO AINDA MAIS ERRADO!

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Sussurros pela Manha, Voce cresceu tao alto, cresceu tao rapido
programme.desc: Os Bravos Guerreiros tentam lutar para sair de um navio de guerra MECAGATOS, mas são capturados pelo Capitão Miau, que pretende afogá-los em areia para gatos. Você cresceu tão alto, cresceu tão rápido

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: O Reflexo do Espelho, Acorrentado ao seu lado
programme.desc: Danny acidentalmente faz um buraco em outra dimensão (enquanto tenta contatar os pais dos Bravos Guerreiros) e abre um portal para um grupo de Bravos Guerreiros de realidade alternativa que têm a intenção de proteger este mundo para seus mestres alienígenas.Quando Beth é deixada por seu novo namorado na festa anual estilo "dia de Sadie Hawkins" em Marte, ela decide competir sozinha contra os outros casais, incluindo os Bravos Guerreiros.

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Do Comodo Interno,Eu so desejo ficar sozinho
programme.desc: Quando Danny e Simpaurso são enviados para a prisão por crimes de tempo, Danny luta para cumprir sua sentença de 1000 anos. Felizmente, seu novo companheiro de cela está lá para ajudar... o Reverendo Batatinha. Depois que o Homem Pudim conta para o Chris sobre as Guerras no Parasox, Chris é deixado sozinho em casa,

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Essa danca nao e pra todo mundo, Alguns momentos roubados
programme.desc: A grande "noite das meninas" de Beth e Plum em um clube virtual da moda, onde humanos não são permitidos, azeda quando um penetra ameaça destruir o clube e talvez a amizade das meninas.Quando Beth decide que é hora dos Bravos Guerreiros conhecerem seu "namorado", Chris luta contra o ciúme venenoso que infecta seu coração! Especialmente quando Zac a acompanha em uma missão com os Bravos Guerreiros...

programme.title: O Dom Da Serpente
programme.desc: Dina, uma jovem que herdou a habilidade sobrenatural de ver os pecados e as fraquezas das outras pessoas olhando nos olhos, precisa salvar sua família. Com a ajuda do pai, que ela não conhecia, Dina terá que escolher entre o seu próprio dom e a magia negra.

programme.title: Em Retirada
programme.desc: Um típico adolescente da cidade viaja até a rural Montana para caçar com seu pai, um homem distante e pouco convencional. Conforme adentram na paisagem, pai e filho tentam se aproximar de alguma maneira. Até que um encontro brutal com um urso pardo muda tudo. Gravemente feridos, o garoto precisa levar o pai a um local seguro antes que seja tarde demais.

programme.title: Conspiração e Poder
programme.desc: Ele conta a história do escândalo de Rathergate, nos dias que antecederam a eleição presidencial de 2004. Quando o apresentador Dan Rather e o diretor da CBS News, eles transmitiram um segmento expondo como o presidente Bush evitou ser recrutado no Vietnã por vantagens políticas do pai, as consequências resultantes acabam por lhes custar seus empregos e reputação

programme.title: Um Homem Comum
programme.desc: Um criminoso de guerra escondido estabelece um relacionamento com sua única conexão com o mundo exterior - sua empregada.

programme.title: RedBad: A Invasão dos Francos
programme.desc: As lutas pelo poder e as guerras entre o Redbad Frisiano e seu inimigo jurado Pepin de Herstal, Senhor dos Francos.

programme.title: RedBad: A Invasão dos Francos
programme.desc: As lutas pelo poder e as guerras entre o Redbad Frisiano e seu inimigo jurado Pepin de Herstal, Senhor dos Francos.

programme.title: Alma de Guerreiro
programme.desc: Seguidores de duas religiões lutam entre si em uma batalha de proporções gigantescas. Um estranho se encontra no meio do conflito e é pressionado a escolher um lado. No final, ele decide que nenhum dos lados merece seu favor e deve lutar por seus próprios desejos.

programme.title: A Última Peça
programme.desc: Paula Stephânia organiza uma festa surpresa para o irmão e, quando está terminando de decorar a casa com muitos dinossauros, descobre que faltava uma peça em um dos brinquedos. Para recuperá-lo, Paula terá que enfrentar o malvado dono de uma loja de brinquedos, vivendo um dia de grandes desafios e aventuras. Será que ela conseguirá terminar a decoração a tempo?

programme.title: Mentes Malignas
programme.desc: Um filme antológico na forma de longa-metragem de horror. Estes segmentos assustadores são recheados de personagens conhecidos como mitos, tradições e contos populares. Criadas para dar lógica aos medos mais sombrios da humanidade, essas histórias lançaram as bases para o que hoje conhecemos como gênero de terror.

programme.title: Black Ops: Operação Secreta
programme.desc: O esquadrão de operações especiais "Hell's Bastards" é enviado para a Europa Oriental no meio de uma guerra civil para recuperar informações. Mas logo após a missão, a unidade fica presa em uma escadaria aterrorizante e interminável. Forçados a subir ou morrer, o grupo logo fica cara a cara com seus pecados passados ​​em uma luta desesperada pela sobrevivência.

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Nao precisa brigar, Pode deixar os seus amigos para tras
programme.desc: Chris acompanha Plum até sua casa para uma cerimônia de maioridade Merewif. Mas quando o pai rigoroso de Plum os pega em trajes comprometedores, Chris deve se envolver em um combate com a Ex ciumenta da Plum por sua honra... e sua vida. Quando Himmel começa a voltar ao seu próprio tempo, Wallow tem que fazer a escolha mais difícil de sua vida: se despedir do amor ou seguir Himmel para o futuro e dizer adeus aos Bravos Guerreiros para sempre!

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Senta e toma um bovillabaisse, Vivendo em um barril de polvora
programme.desc: Quando Robochris rouba a Baleia Espacial para visitar o lendário Willy Azul com o poder de transformá-lo em um "menino de verdade", os Bravos Guerreiros progressivamente são nocauteados, sequestrados e presos dentro de uma baleia viva e respirante. Depois disso, as coisas ficam estranhas...Quando Chris e Beth ficam presos no holobanho durante um jogo atrevido de "Sete Luas ao Redor de Urano", o resto dos Bravos Guerreiros deve lidar com um ataque ao Esconderijo Invisível liderado pelo vingativo Capitão Miau.

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Esta nao e minha linda casa, PEGADAS NA ARVORE DO JARDIM
programme.desc: Quando Danny faz contato com sua mãe por meio de uma sessão espírita, ela o envia em uma visita urgente à casa de sua infância em Terras Ermas Marcianas. Lá, memórias antigas, revelações fantásticas e um bilhete de loteria premiado aguardam... junto com uma raça de baratas sencientes..Eita! Alguém comeu todos os cupcakes! Agora cabe ao detetive Gatomia resolver o crime antes do jantar e garantir que o culpado receba sua justa sobremesa... que é, para dizer o mínimo, sobremesa nenhuma!

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Acho que vou perder esse ano, Nada continua igual
programme.desc: Enquanto Chris luta para chegar em casa a tempo para a festa de Wanksgiving, os outros guerreiros se preparam para criar novas tradições de feriado. Quando um Globerdotempo mata os Bravos Guerreiros, eles se encontram restaurados a um 'ponto de salvamento' anterior... onde são atacados por um Globerdotempo e restaurados a um 'ponto de salvamento' anterior.

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Eu te devo pelo seu amor, A noite, quando o programa acaba
programme.desc: Quando um bobo da corte espacial declara que o quarto do Danny é parte de um reino espacial feudal e Danny um prisioneiro político, os Bravos Guerreiros se envolvem na intriga e nas tramas nefastas que acontecem dentro do Castelo Gordon. Quando o sintetizador de comida do Esconderijo Invisível ganha consciência, os Bravos Guerreiros o chamam de E.D.G.A.R. e começam a ensinar os mistérios da vida...

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Eu so vejo estatica, Eu estou surpreso, eu vou mordido. eu estou viciado, eu fui cozido
programme.desc: Quando Danny começa a ficar sério com sua nova namorada totalmente real (que ele nunca conheceu), os outros Bravos Guerreiros começam a suspeitar que ele está sendo enganado. Os Lutadores Corajosos protegem as partes difusas do universo das partes viscosas, ao mesmo tempo em que criam famílias. Mas as coisas não são tão tranquilas quanto parecem no grupo de heróis.

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: ABACAXI. BANANA. CHILI, Danca no fogo
programme.desc: A caminho de salvar os Huxtabites, os Bravos Guerreiros fazem uma parada rápida para um lanche no Planeta Marte. Mas a atração do consumismo infinito desenfreado logo ameaça destruí-los.A guerra entre os Senhores das Emoções chega a um clímax dramático em uma “maratona de tatança” com Beth Tezuka como o prêmio final!

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Oficio DO PAI, Uma menina em um milhao
programme.desc: Quando Wallow acha um ovo alienígena abandonado, seus instintos protetores entram em ação e ele promete cuidar dele como se fosse seu. Mas a dificuldade de criar um filho afeta o pai adolescente, tanto mentalmente quanto fisicamente... Enquanto Plum e Beth vão ao shopping para uma visita de modelagem de robôs, Chris descobre algumas verdades difíceis sobre Zachary Ryan.

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: O suficiente pra vida inteira, As coisas serao as mesmas de novo?
programme.desc: Quando Danny cai em um planeta desolado, ele acha um diário de bordo holográfico de um acidente anterior com uma tripulação. Danny deve seguir essas descrições para garantir sua própria sobrevivência e encontrar uma maneira de sair do planeta alienígena ou ficar preso lá para sempre. É o confronto final entre os Bravos Guerreiros e os Mecagatos, mas Chris não aparece, pois se envolve em sua própria batalha pessoal... com Karswell!

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.desc: Os Lutadores Corajosos protegem as partes difusas do universo das partes viscosas, ao mesmo tempo em que criam famílias. Mas as coisas não são tão tranquilas quanto parecem no grupo de heróis. E quando a arqui-inimiga deles, a RoboLorde, escapa, eles devem deixar de lado suas diferenças para lutar juntos uma última vez...Os Bravos Guerreiros estavam prestes a se desentender, mas agora estão prestes a ser desmascarados pela RoboLorde e seu exército de RoboBots gigantes...

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Este e o Seu Paraiso, Muito alto. Muito longe, muito cedo
programme.desc: Chris Kirkman está morto. Mas a tristeza dos Bravos Guerreiros é demais para o Gatomia, então ele decide viajar para a vida após a morte para trazer o Chris de volta...Quando os Bravos Guerreiros descobrem um planeta onde o tempo passa super rápido, eles acidentalmente o povoam com versões em miniatura de si mesmos.

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: A Libertacao Consciente do Estado Feminino, Sua Vida Esta em Suas Maos
programme.desc: As tentativas de Beth de se estabelecer em seu novo papel como capitã dos Bravos Guerreiros são frustradas por uma sociedade de homens e o senhor deles que deveriam simplesmente calar a boca e deixá-la salvá-los. Danny e Chris pousam em um planeta alienígena e descobrem antigos xenóglifos proclamando Danny como "O Escolhido". Mas até onde Danny está disposto a ir para cumprir uma previsão antiga?

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: A Multidao que Estou Vendo, Todo mundo esta chegando, deixe seu corpo na porta
programme.desc: Após terminar com Zachary Ryan, Beth decide que precisa relaxar e tirar um tempo pra ela, longe dos outros Bravos Guerreiros, encontrando consolo em uma gangue de punks, as “Malvadonas”. Quando o resto da galera se recusa a curtir após uma série de missões bem-sucedidas,

programme.title: Bravos Guerreiros
programme.sub-title: Minha unica fraqueza e uma lista de crimes, Decida o que voce quer de mim
programme.desc: Quando os Bravos Guerreiros descobrem que o Gatomia estava furtando em lojas durante suas aventuras interplanetárias, Chris assume a responsabilidade de ensiná-lo o que é certo e errado. Quando Danny sente que os Bravos Guerreiros estariam melhor sem ele, um ser estranho de uma dimensão extra mostra a ele como seria a vida se ele nunca tivesse existido.

programme.title: S.O.S Mulheres ao Mar 2
programme.desc: Adriana, uma escritora bem-sucedida, segue feliz em seu romance com André, que está prestes a lançar sua mais nova coleção de moda durante um cruzeiro pelo Caribe. Ao saber que a ex-noiva dele vai acompanhá-lo na viagem em busca de uma reconciliação, Adriana chama suas fiéis escudeiras Luzia e Dialinda para embarcar no navio com eles.

programme.title: Desejos da Tarde
programme.desc: Rachel tenta apimentar seu casamento com uma visita a um clube de strip-tease. Ela faz amizade com McKenna, que lhe oferece uma dança sensual. McKenna se muda para a casa da família de Rachel e se torna babá de seu filho.

programme.title: Enquanto Somos Jovens
programme.desc: Josh e Cornelia, um casal sem filhos começa a passar mais tempo com um jovem casal de hipsters. Um jovem aspirante a documentarista, uma vocação que ações Josh. Logo o casal mais velho começa a desfrutar da energia transmitida pela geração mais jovem, mas, eventualmente, Josh começa a suspeitar que seu novo melhor amigo pode não ser tão honesto e confiável como o esperado.

programme.title: Colossal
programme.desc: Depois de perder o emprego e ser expulsa de seu apartamento pelo namorado, Gloria deixa sua vida em Nova York e retorna à sua cidade natal. Quando o noticiário informa que uma criatura gigantesca está destruindo Seul, na Coreia, Gloria percebe que ela mesma está ligada a esse fenômeno distante. Gloria descobrirá por que ela tem um efeito tão colossal sobre o destino da Terra.

programme.title: Ataque dos Zumbis
programme.desc: Um empregado medíocre de uma fabricante de armas precisa sobreviver ao caos dentro do escritório quando seus colegas se transformam em maníacos assassinos depois de tomarem uma misteriosa bebida.

programme.title: Hecho en Chinatown
programme.desc: Es Goodfellas y Ip Man cuando un joven chino don nadie se propone convertirse en Don de la mafia italiana. Pero las tensiones ya son altas entre las dos culturas a medida que se mueven en el territorio del otro y un comisionado de delitos sucios juega en ambos lados. Resulta que ganarse el respeto, encontrar el amor y descubrir su identidad no es tan fácil. Tendrá que luchar para llegar a la cima.

programme.title: Hacker - Privacidad Violada
programme.desc: Una joven encuentra su vida patas arriba cuando rechaza los avances de un hacker adolescente. Cuando él pone su vida patas arriba, ella debe encontrar una manera de defenderse.

programme.title: Hecho en Chinatown
programme.desc: Es Goodfellas y Ip Man cuando un joven chino don nadie se propone convertirse en Don de la mafia italiana. Pero las tensiones ya son altas entre las dos culturas a medida que se mueven en el territorio del otro y un comisionado de delitos sucios juega en ambos lados. Resulta que ganarse el respeto, encontrar el amor y descubrir su identidad no es tan fácil. Tendrá que luchar para llegar a la cima.

programme.title: Top 10: Secretos y misterios
programme.desc: Hoy echamos un vistazo a aquellos lugares con poderes curativos, según algunos.

programme.title: USS Seaviper: Mision al Abismo
programme.desc: El submarino alemán U-234, del puerto de Kiel, comercia con los japoneses. El USS Seaviper debe localizar y detener este peligroso intercambio. El capitán del USS Seaviper debe desembarcar para realizar un reconocimiento en una isla cerca de Sumatra, pero el barco queda en manos de Mister Cutter, después de que el oficial ejecutivo resulta herido en batalla. Un conflicto entre Cutter y el jefe del barco pone al submarino en peligro. Seaviper está atrapado debajo de la superficie, con menos oxígeno, y un destructor japonés los caza desde arriba. Los daños sufridos por el barco también ponen en duda su supervivencia. Deben luchar contra el destructor japonés y llevar la información sobre el U-235 a Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: Attack: Part One
programme.desc: En esta película de acción y ciencia ficción, un exsoldado que queda paralizado tras un ataque terrorista se convierte en sujeto de un programa experimental de supersoldados que usa inteligencia artificial y cibernética. Al transformarse en el primer supersoldado de la India, debe enfrentar tanto su trauma interno como las amenazas externas para defender a su país.

programme.title: Cerco de Terror: Ataque Al Templo
programme.desc: Inspirada en hechos reales, la película narra la história heroica de los comandos NSG, que intervienen para salvar a personas inocentes cuando los terroristas atacan un templo en Gujarat.

programme.title: Aterrizaje Forzoso
programme.desc: Los ocupantes de un avión privado celebran una fiesta a bordo, cuando el aparato es tomado por secuestradores.

programme.title: Matar o Morir
programme.desc: Cuando a Jack, un asesino a sueldo de Londres, se le devuelve la vida y se le da la oportunidad de salvar a su hija, se convierte en una carrera contra el tiempo para matar o ser asesinado.

programme.title: Experimento Filadelfia
programme.desc: En 1943, dos jóvenes oficiales de la marina tomaron parte voluntariamente en un experimento militar altamente secreto que consistía en impedir que su barco fuera detectado por el radar enemigo. Un error imprevisible los trasladará al futuro, al año 1984.

programme.title: Cerco de Terror 26/11 – La Serie
programme.desc: Kasab e Ismail lanzan un ataque al Hospital Cama. Mientras la NSG se moviliza hacia Mumbai, la policía de la ciudad se enfrenta a los terroristas en un duro enfrentamiento. Parvati transmite en vivo desde un club donde los sobrevivientes están atrapados.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: El equipo se propone ayudar a Ollie y a su papá a encontrar una solución sin pesticidas para una plaga de pulgones en su jardín de rosas. Pero cuando Astro y Astro Kitty se encogen en sus mini-robos para encontrarse con los pulgones, descubren que los bichos son pirañas sin cerebro que devoran todo a su paso, incluidos los robots. ¡No es el mejor momento para que los chicos se queden atascados en el modo mini-robo debido a un mal funcionamiento de OT2 en el AstroLab!

programme.title: La Venganza de Iffet
programme.desc: Los sueños de İffet de casarse con Cemil, un taxista, se desarman cuando él la agrede sexualmente.

programme.title: La Venganza de Iffet
programme.desc: Los sueños de İffet de casarse con Cemil, un taxista, se desarman cuando él la agrede sexualmente.

programme.title: Diddy: La Caída El Monstruo
programme.desc: El magnate del hip-hop caído en desgracia, Sean "Diddy" Combs, ya no pudo comprar su salida de los problemas cuando un gran jurado lo acusó en septiembre de 2024 de una conspiración de crimen organizado que incluía tráfico sexual, trabajo forzado y soborno. Sin fianza, iba a la cárcel.

programme.title: La Orden Judicial: La Ley de Breaker
programme.desc: Un simple intercambio de prisioneros lleva al alguacil Breaker a luchar contra un grupo de bandidos por el destino de un pequeño pueblo.

programme.title: La Cacería: En el fin del mundo
programme.sub-title: La Caceria: En el fin del mundo - Episodio 01
programme.desc: La pesadilla comienza cuando José Mirkovic, un adolescente solitario y alumno de un colegio de curas, desaparece tras una noche de fiesta. Ante la indiferencia policial y el silencio de la Iglesia, su madre, Susana Rivera, inicia una cruzada para descubrir la verdad. Tras semanas sin respuestas, aparece un extraño que ofrece esperanza: César Rojas, ex policía convertido en investigador privado, marcado por un pasado turbulento. Junto a la joven oficial Antonia Loij, Rojas sigue el rastro del enigmático padre Correa, ex director del colegio de José, quien parece esconder más de un secreto. Mientras Susana y Rojas luchan por resolver el caso y descubrir qué le sucedió a José, en Santiago el capitán Rodrigo Carrasco, antiguo compañero de Rojas en la policía, recibe una alerta sobre el caso. programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Óscar le da su merecido a Fernando, quien pone a Gabriela a elegir entre él y sus hijas, las hermanas convencen a Jimena de que se mude, Armando le pide a Rosario que no vuelva a la hacienda.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Dínora le advierte a Belinda que no revele su paradero, pero Martín ya sabe que ella visita la hacienda. Los Reyes organizan la bienvenida a Jimena, Franco les regala a ella y Óscar una casa.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan siente envidia de Óscar y Jimena y presiona a Norma para que también se mude a la hacienda. En un arrebato de celos, Concha llega a la fiesta y le dispara a Leonidas al verlo con Melisa.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Norma asiste a la exposición de caballos, Carmela hostiga a la empleada que cuida al bebé y se queda con él con malas intenciones, Norma se devuelve a tiempo y la saca a empujones del cuarto.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Las Elizondo se preocupan por los pésimos resultados obtenidos en la feria de caballos y descubren que Fernando vendió los mejores ejemplares de la hacienda, Gabriela lo encara y él la enreda.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Sara ve a Malcolm cuando espía a Norma en la tina y las dos lo acorralan para caerle a golpes. Quintina y Dominga se van a las manos por Olegario, Ruth se entera de quién es su verdadera mamá.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Norma revisa los informes de la hacienda y comprueba sus sospechas, Eva detiene a Ruth cuando se marcha de la casa y le aclara por qué la abandonó, Quintina y Dominga se vengan de Olegario.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan llega con la policía a reclamarle a Fernando la golpiza a Olegario, ambos son llevados a la comisaría. Por las noches la hacienda Elizondo se convierte en un casino de apuestas y negocios.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Norma atrapa a Fernando con una mujer en la cama, él envuelve a Gabriela en otra mentira y pelea con Norma en el balcón desde donde cae por accidente. Concha salva a los Reyes de una emboscada.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Fernando aprovecha su quebranto para manipular a Gabriela y amenaza de muerte a Norma. Franco cree que ella y Sara corren peligro y les recomienda que salgan de la hacienda cuanto antes.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Dínora tiene en la mira de un fusil a Sara y espera la orden de Rosario para disparar mientras Franco y Óscar organizan una fiesta para su sobrino Juan David. Mejora la relación de Ruth y Eva.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Tras salir del hospital, Fernando se apura a ejecutar su plan y ataca a Norma con la complicidad de sus mayordomos. Gabriela empieza a desconfiar al hallar a Malcolm y Carmela en su cuarto.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. programme.title: LMN's
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes inconsolable when Gomez donates the family antique harpsichord to a collector. Gomez and Morticia offer Lurch a balalaika and a set of drums. When this proves unsatisfactory, Gomez and Fester decide to build a new harpsichord.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley return in tears from trick-or-treating because a neighbor has told them there is no such thing as a witch. Morticia and Gomez plan to prove to the children that they do exist--by summoning a witch to a séance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez (John Astin) loses his memory after hitting his head; he fails to recognize Morticia (Carolyn Jones) and says the house looks like a condemned museum. The Addamses take turns hitting Gomez on the head trying to help him regain his memory.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt And The Vocational Counselor
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez are worried about Cousin Itt because he spends his days sleeping and dreaming in his tiny room. They decide that Itt would make an excellent marriage counselor, and pretend to be a couple with a failing marriage.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's electrical output fails abruptly. Should they call a doctor or an electrician to bring Fester back? Morticia prescribes a bowl of porcupine mold, and both she and Gomez agree that long exposure to moon rays would be beneficial.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester's pen pal, Madelyn, is coming to visit. Fester panics, as he has described himself as handsome, heroic and romantic. Gomez and Morticia agree that all Fester needs is a toupee and they help him make several styles.

programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.

programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.title: Sprinter Galore

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting on the shore, enjoying the sun, when he sees something repeatedly poking out of the water, sparking his curiosity. He puts on his underwater robot mask and dives into the ocean. At first, all he finds are rocks and coral, but suddenly, big, round eyes are staring at him from a gray rock. He flees in panic, but when he realizes that it is an octopus whose tentacles are tangled in plastic waste, he quickly frees his new friend from this unpleasant situation, and they dance happily together in the water

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: GAME ON? ROOKIE AND THE COMPUTER
programme.desc: Rookie comes across an office cubicle with a computer on the table and is immediately fascinated. He presses some keys, a little character appears on the screen, and a computer game starts. Very excited, Rookie continues to press different keys. When in the end he wins the race and earns a trophy, the computer suddenly takes Rookie‘s photo and prints it out. However, the printing doesn‘t stop, and soon the whole floor is covered with photos before Rookie finally manages to shut down the computer and stop the madness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: LET IT BEEEEE! ROOKIE AND THE BEE
programme.desc: Rookie finds a wooden box, knocks on it, and then shakes it. What a bad idea! The whole swarm of bees chases him, and he has to hide in the bushes. After the swarm is gone, he finds a tired and exhausted bee on the ground. Rookie has the idea to rescue the little bee with a sugar cube. The whole beehive is grateful, and Rookie learns a lot about the work of these useful little friends.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SNOWBALL EFFECT? ROOKIE AND THE POLAR BEAR
programme.desc: Rookie is happily stomping through the snow when he suddenly gets hit by several snowballs. A pair of cheeky polar bears try to engage him in a playful snowball fight. But Rookie outwits them by hiding in the snow, causing the bears to stumble and then get hit by his surprise robot snowball machine. After the snowy confusion turns to laughter, everyone shares a moment of fun and happiness.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: SPRING, SUMMER, FALL & WINTER - ROOKIE AND THE 4 SEASONS
programme.desc: From the window of his house Rookie watches the four seasons pass by and thinks of his friends and the great fun and adventures they had throughout the year: The bees that make everything bloom and the cheeky little ladybug in spring; a day at the beach, snorkeling with friends and a water battle in summer; fl ying kites, fun in the rain and his friend the squirrel getting ready in autumn and building snowmen, snowballs and sledding fun in winter.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: READY, SET, GO! ROOKIE AND THE RABBIT
programme.desc: Rookie is relaxing in the sun when something rushes past him, leaving him in a cloud of dust. Using his telescope, he spots a racing rabbit, and with the tasty prospect of a sweet carrot for the winner, he manages to persuade it to take part in a race. Ready – steady – and off they go: Even though the rabbit stumbles and Rookie has to help, they finish the race together, tumbling happily over the finish line.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BALANCE IN PINK – ROOKIE AND THE FLAMINGO
programme.desc: On his stroll around a lake, Rookie spots a group of pink flamingos gracefully balancing on one leg. Curious, Rookie tries to imitate them and, after practicing a little, manages to do so quite well. But suddenly there‘s a loud splash and Rookie discovers a flamingo struggling to stand on one leg, falling over and over. Offering to help, Rookie comes up with an excellent idea - a pair of roller skates! And there, slowly but surely, the flamingo learns to skate gracefully like a ballerina and to balance on one leg as well.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.sub-title: BOUNCE, REBOUND - SCORE! ROOKIE AND THE GIRAFFE
programme.desc: Rookie is out for a walk on a beautiful day when he suddenly hears a rhythmic sound in the distance. Curious as always, he goes out to investigate and finds a young giraffe playing basketball, skillfully dribbling and bouncing the ball into a basketball hoop high in the trees. Of course, Rookie wants to join in, but he has a few things to learn before their first game. In the end, they impress each other with their skills and tricks.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing - An Unforgettable Trip, South Lake, Part Two
programme.desc: This show was filmed in late October of 2019. Four months prior, in June of 2019, Tim Carnahan was diagnosed with Glioblastoma, Brain Cancer. According to Tim's medical team, his life expectancy could be between three months and 18 months. Fast forward to now, 2020; today's update is one we hoped would never come. With a heavy heart and tear-filled eyes, we share with you that Tim Carnahan has passed away after battling for close to 12 months. It only fits that the last words to pass his lips were I love you, Lory, and keep fishing. While his time on earth was cut short, the amount of joy he experienced and shared with others was genuinely tremendous and will never be forgotten. If you would like to help out in any way, lory and friends have put together a Go Fund Me page to ease the financial burden of medical bills and afford lory some time to greave and transition into life without Tim. We love you, Tim. Rest in peace, buddy.

programme.title: FishON! | "Trophy Walleye Adventure on Pierre Lake"
programme.desc: Join us as we kick off Season 7 with an unforgettable adventure north of Cochrane, Ontario, on the pristine waters of Pierre Lake. We team up with Mark Froud from Dunn Right Outfitters, an expert in Northern Ontario fishing, to target trophy walleye. Experience the thrill of reeling in massive catches while surrounded by breathtaking wilderness, and gain valuable tips and insights from Mark to enhance your own fishing techniques. This episode sets the tone for a season filled with excitement, exploration, and exceptional angling.

programme.title: Stoked on Fishing | Party Boat El Dorado Takes on Cortez Bank: Part Two
programme.desc: Fishing out west has been fantastic this year, but eventually, the fish move or disappear due to currents, weather, or heavy traffic. However, there are always some offshore banks that have resident fish on or around them year-round, and one of those spots is called the Cortez Bank. You can always guarantee one thing: if you make it 110 miles, you'll catch some big Rockfish. Additionally, if Mother Nature and currents work out in your favor, there can be some incredible Yellowtail fishing on the bank. Today, we're rallying up for our "Stoked On Fishing" day and a half charter on board the one and only El Dorado, a top vessel in the Long Beach sport fishing scene. With anticipation running high, we can't wait to cast our lines and see what kind of adventures await us on the open waters.

programme.sub-title: Stoked on Fishing — $22,000 Catalina Island Dream Trip
programme.desc: This past summer (2019), we met a new friend Jason, the CEO of the Catalina Island medical center in the city of Avalon. Jason mentioned that he was in charge of a campaign for the Catalina Island Medical Center Foundation. This campaign aims to raise money to build Catalina Island, a much-needed, state-of-the-art medical center. Jason asked us if we could be one of the big-ticket auction items from the list. We would provide a three-night stay on the stoked on a fishing yacht, two days of fishing on our Stoked On Fishing Charters 35-foot everglades, and provide fantastic food and drinks when we arrived back in Avalon. We love Catalina, and the idea of creating a hospital for the future of the Island was a no-brainer. We couldn't let this great opportunity go to waste and had epic two days of fishing in San Clemente Island with some new friends.
